title: Jerry Iger's Famous Features #1 Flamingo Pacific Comics 1984 Chiodo Cover
conditionDescription: Clean cream cover with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Jerry Iger's Famous Features #1 (1984), Pacific Comics - featuring Flamingo. Painted Joe Chiodo cover. $1.50 cover price.

Back cover: Pathways to Fantasy ad (Bruce Jones Associates).

Condition: clean cover with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
